key_insight: BINEVAL turns LLM evaluation into a set of interpretable binary questions, then aggregates the answers into calibrated scores that are easier to debug and improve.
engineering_relevance: It offers a task-agnostic, training-free way to evaluate generative models with more transparent failure analysis and practical prompt-optimization feedback.
method: Use a meta-prompt to generate atomic, fine-grained evaluation questions from the task prompt.
Answer each binary question independently for every model output to obtain question-level verdicts.
Aggregate verdicts into multi-dimensional and overall scores for interpretable evaluation and iterative prompt improvement.
evidence_signal: Across SummEval, Topical-Chat, and QAGS, the method matches or outperforms strong baselines such as UniEval and G-Eval, with particularly strong results on factual consistency.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the generated questions and LLM judgments, so poorly designed prompts or judge bias can still affect reliability.
paper_title: Ask, Don't Judge: Binary Questions for Interpretable LLM Evaluation and Self-Improvement
